name: parity-corpus
description: Corpus fixture for the faithfulness parity test. Exercises the surfaces whose resolution must be byte-identical between the executor and preview: a static-prompt agent (interpolates vars + initial input), a static map (per-item ${item}/${index} resolution), a parameterized agent path, and a static code.run command. NOT a shipped example.
